proposals.rationale: Empty event where one qty=2 fits but two do not (2<=3<4). Classic overbooking race: check-then-insert can let both jack and jill succeed with reserved=4>capacity.
Empty event exactly fitting both requests (2+2=4). Both should commit with reserved=4; exposes lost update (reserved=2) or spurious rejection under concurrent increments.
Near-full event with existing reservation sum matching reserved (3/5). Only one more qty=2 fits (remaining=2); second must reject. Tests contended read-modify-write of reserved plus inserts.
Almost-full event with reserved=2/3 (remaining=1). Neither qty=2 should succeed; both must reject. Exposes false success / overbooking to 4-6 when availability check races.
